name: io.github.MarcinWolnyEU/ai-image-router-mcp
title: AI Image Router
description: Image and short video via OpenRouter, Mistral, Eden AI, fal.ai, plus local cutouts, GIFs and icons.

environmentVariables.name: AIR_MCP_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to a config.json made by the setup wizard. Defaults to ~/.ai-image-router-mcp/config.json.

environmentVariables.name: AIR_MCP_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory for config, token files, downloaded models, logs and generated media. Defaults to ~/.ai-image-router-mcp.
